title: Inventory EWS-dependent cross-tenant sharing in Exchange Online
summary: Read-only Exchange Online PowerShell that lists enabled Organization Relationships, Availability Address Spaces, Sharing Policies and how many mailboxes each Sharing Policy covers, as input to the Cross-Tenant Access Policy migration.
code:
Connect-ExchangeOnline
$FormatEnumerationLimit = -1

# Free/Busy and MailTips partners (EWS-based)
Get-OrganizationRelationship | Where-Object { $_.Enabled } |
  Format-List Name, DomainNames, FreeBusyAccessEnabled, FreeBusyAccessLevel, FreeBusyAccessScope, MailTipsAccessEnabled, MailTipsAccessLevel, MailTipsAccessScope, TargetSharingEpr, TargetAutodiscoverEpr, TargetApplicationUri

# Availability Address Spaces (not EWS-dependent for Microsoft 365 partners; optional to migrate)
Get-AvailabilityAddressSpace | Format-List ForestName, AccessMethod, TargetAutodiscoverEpr, TargetServiceEpr, TargetTenantId

# Calendar sharing policies and their mailbox coverage
Get-SharingPolicy | Format-List Name, Enabled, Domains, Default
Get-EXOMailbox -ResultSize Unlimited -RecipientTypeDetails UserMailbox,SharedMailbox -Properties SharingPolicy |
  Group-Object SharingPolicy | Select-Object Name, Count
notes: Read-only. Requires the Organization Management role in Exchange Online.
Cross-Tenant Access Policy only covers partners hosted in Microsoft 365; keep policies that serve on-premises or hybrid partners.
Do not remove calendar Sharing Policies until XTAP calendar sharing has reached your tenant.

source.label: Find cross-tenant sharing that still depends on EWS
